```{r, Load and Prepare (Real) Data}

library(dplyr)

df <- read.csv("Voter_Reg_STRICT.csv")
head(df)
nrow(df) # 12927

## Prepare variables ##

# Set reference level as the control conditon
df$condition <- relevel(as.factor(df$condition), ref = "ControlCondition")

# Make sure link click, register, and vote variables are factor
df$linkClicked <- as.factor(df$linkClicked)
df$register <- as.factor(df$register)
df$vote <- as.factor(df$vote)

```

```{r, Calculate Means and Proportions from Real Data}

# Conditions
conditions_table <- table(df$condition)
conditions <- names(conditions_table)
conditions

# Condition proportions
prob_conditions <- prop.table(conditions_table)
prob_conditions

# States 
state_table <- table(df$state)
states <- names(state_table)
states

state_counts <- as.numeric(state_table)
probs_state <- state_counts / sum(state_counts)
probs_state

# Simulate data to demo analysis code functionality
# n and overall Ms and SDs match those of the true data 
# All else random, and as such, results will not match those reported in the main paper and supplement 

# Seed
set.seed(1234)

### Parameters ### 

n <- nrow(df)

## Continuous demographics ##

# Age
age_mean <- mean(df$age, na.rm = T)
age_sd   <- sd(df$age, na.rm = T)

# Income
income_mean <- mean(df$income, na.rm = T)
income_sd   <- sd(df$income, na.rm = T)

# Education
edu_mean <- mean(df$edu, na.rm = T)
edu_sd   <- sd(df$edu, na.rm = T)

# Ideology scale (social and economic)
ide_mean <- mean(df$ide, na.rm = T)
ide_sd   <- sd(df$ide, na.rm = T)

## Additional continuous predictors ##

# Pre-intervention intention to register
pre_intention_mean <- mean(df$pre_intention, na.rm = T)
pre_intention_sd <- sd(df$pre_intention, na.rm = T)

# Political interest
interest_mean <- mean(df$interest, na.rm = T)
interest_sd <- sd(df$interest, na.rm = T)

# Political knowledge 
knowledge_mean <- mean(df$knowledge, na.rm = T)
knowledge_sd <- sd(df$knowledge, na.rm = T)

# COVI
COVI_mean <- mean(df$FinalCOVI, na.rm = T)
COVI_sd <-  sd(df$FinalCOVI, na.rm = T)

# Continuous DVs 

# Voting Intentions
voteInt_mean <- mean(df$voteInt, na.rm = T)
voteInt_sd <- sd(df$voteInt, na.rm = T)

# Trust in branches of government scale (exec, legis, and jud)
trust_branch_mean <- mean(df$trust_branch, na.rm = T)
trust_branch_sd <- sd(df$trust_branch, na.rm = T)

# Trust in elections
trust_elect_mean <- mean(df$trust_elect, na.rm = T)
trust_elect_sd <- sd(df$trust_elect, na.rm = T)

# General trust (aggregate)
trust_agg_mean <- mean(df$trust_agg, na.rm = T)
trust_agg_sd <- sd(df$trust_agg, na.rm = T)

# Efficacy scale (efficacy items 1, 2, and 3)
efficacy_mean <- mean(df$efficacy, na.rm = T)
efficacy_sd <- sd(df$efficacy, na.rm = T)

# Norms scale (norms items 1 and 2)
norms_mean <- mean(df$norms, na.rm = T)
norms_sd <- sd(df$norms, na.rm = T)

## Binary DVs ##

# Link click
link_prob <- mean(df$linkClicked_n, na.rm = TRUE)
link_prob

# Registration
register_prob <- mean(df$register_n, na.rm = TRUE)
register_prob

# Voter turnout
vote_prob <- mean(df$vote_n, na.rm = TRUE)
vote_prob

# Confirmation of registration
reg_confirm_ny_prob <- mean(df$reg_confirm_ny, na.rm = TRUE) # no yes
reg_confirm_ny_prob

reg_confirm_nl_prob <- mean(df$reg_confirm_nl, na.rm = TRUE) # no later
reg_confirm_nl_prob

```

```{r, Simulate Data}

# Function to simulate categorical variables using observed proportions
sample_like <- function(x, n) {
  sample(
    x,
    size = n,
    replace = TRUE
  )
}

### Simulation ### 

sim_data <- tibble(
  
  # Continuous variables
  age = rnorm(n, mean = age_mean, sd = age_sd),
  income = rnorm(n, mean = income_mean, sd = income_sd),
  edu = rnorm(n, mean = edu_mean, sd = edu_sd),
  ide = rnorm(n, mean = ide_mean, sd = ide_sd),
  pre_intention = rnorm(n, mean = pre_intention_mean, sd = pre_intention_sd),
  interest = rnorm(n, mean = interest_mean, sd = interest_sd),
  knowledge = rnorm(n, mean = knowledge_mean, sd = knowledge_sd),
  COVI = rnorm(n, mean = COVI_mean, sd = COVI_sd),
  trust_branch = rnorm(n, mean = trust_branch_mean, sd = trust_branch_sd),
  trust_elect = rnorm(n, mean = trust_elect_mean, sd = trust_elect_sd),
  trust_agg = rnorm(n, mean = trust_agg_mean, sd = trust_agg_sd),
  efficacy = rnorm(n, mean = efficacy_mean, sd = efficacy_sd),
  norms = rnorm(n, mean = norms_mean, sd = norms_sd),
  voteInt = rnorm(n, mean = voteInt_mean, sd = voteInt_sd),

  # Categorical variables 
  
  # Condition (11)
  condition = factor(sample_like(df$condition, n)),

  # State
  state = sample_like(df$state, n),
  
  # Swing state status
  swing = sample_like(df$swing, n),

  # Region
  region = sample_like(df$region, n),
  
  # Gender
  gender_r = sample_like(df$gender_r, n),
  
  # Race (all categories)
  race = sample_like(df$race, n),
  
  # Candidate preference (binary)
  vote_today_bin = sample_like(df$vote_today_bin, n),
  
  # Link clicks
  linkClicked_n = rbinom(n, 1, link_prob),
  
  # Registration
  register_n = rbinom(n, 1, register_prob),

  # Voting
  vote_n = rbinom(n, 1, vote_prob),
  
  # Confirmation of registration
  reg_confirm_ny = rbinom(n, 1, reg_confirm_ny_prob),
  
  reg_confirm_nl = rbinom(n, 1, reg_confirm_nl_prob) 
  )


# Add ID
sim_data <- dplyr::mutate(sim_data, ResponseId = row_number()) %>%
  relocate(ResponseId, .before=age)

# Check
head(sim_data)

```

```{r, Clean Categorical Variables}

### Condition ### 

table(sim_data$condition) 

# Control vs intervention (binary)
sim_data$condition_binary <- ifelse(sim_data$condition == "ControlCondition", "ControlCondition", "Intervention")
sim_data$condition_binary <- factor(sim_data$condition_binary, levels = c("ControlCondition", "Intervention"))
table(sim_data$condition_binary)

### Gender ### 

table(sim_data$gender_r)

# Binary
sim_data$gend_bin <- ifelse(sim_data$gender_r == "Man", 0, 
                            ifelse(sim_data$gender_r == "Woman", 1, NA)) %>%
  as.numeric()

table(sim_data$gend_bin)

# Recode gender to get women = 0 for interactions
sim_data$gend_bin_r <- ifelse(sim_data$gend_bin == 1,0,1)
table(sim_data$gend_bin)
table(sim_data$gend_bin_r)

# Effects coded 
sim_data$gend_e <- ifelse(sim_data$gender_r == "Man", -.5, 
                          ifelse(sim_data$gender_r == "Woman", .5, NA)) %>%
  as.numeric() # Effects codes must be numeric

table(sim_data$gend_e)


### Race ###

table(sim_data$race)

# Combine ME since both less than .5% of sample and models not estimating
sim_data <- sim_data %>%
  mutate(race_me_combined = case_when(
    race == "White" ~ "White",
    race == "Black" ~ "Black",
    race == "Latinx" ~ "Latinx",
    race == "Asian" ~ "Asian",
    race == "Native" ~ "Native",
    race == "Multiracial" ~ "Multiracial",
    race %in% c("MEA", "MEnonA") ~ "ME",  
    race == "Other" ~ "Other",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>%
    as.factor())

sim_data$race_me_combined <- factor(sim_data$race_me_combined, 
                                     levels = c("White", "Asian", "Black", "Latinx", "ME", "Native", "Multiracial", "Other"))

table(sim_data$race_me_combined) 

# Simple effects code race variable manually (use combined ME for sake of model convergence)

# Race list
race_loop <- as.factor(c("White", "Asian", "Black", "Latinx", "ME", "Native", "Multiracial", "Other"))

# Loop through to create effects coding
for (race_me_combined in race_loop) {
  effect_var <- paste0(race_me_combined, "_E")
  sim_data[[effect_var]] <- ifelse(sim_data$race_me_combined == race_me_combined, 7/8, -1/8)
  mean_val <- mean(sim_data[[effect_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(race_me_combined, "Effect:", mean_val, "\n")
}

# Binary race (white versus non-white)
sim_data <- sim_data %>%
  mutate(race_bin = case_when(
    race == "White" ~ "0",
    race == "Black" ~ "1",
    race == "Latinx" ~ "1",
    race == "Asian" ~ "1",
    race == "Native" ~ "1",
    race == "Multiracial" ~ "1",
    race == "MEA" ~ "1",  
    race == "MEnonA" ~ "1",
    race == "Other" ~ "1",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>%
    as.factor())

# Reverse score
sim_data$race_bin_r <- ifelse(sim_data$race_bin == 0,1,0)

table(sim_data$race_bin)
table(sim_data$race_bin_r)

# Effects code binary race

sim_data$race_bin_e <- ifelse(sim_data$race_bin == "0", -.5, 
                       ifelse(sim_data$race_bin == "1", .5, NA))

sim_data$race_bin_e <- as.numeric(sim_data$race_bin_e)

table(sim_data$race_bin_e)

###  Swing state ### 

# Reverse score
sim_data$swing_r <- ifelse(sim_data$swing == 0,1,0)
table(sim_data$swing)
table(sim_data$swing_r)

# Effects code 
sim_data$swing_E <- ifelse(sim_data$swing == 0,-.5,.5)
table(sim_data$swing)
table(sim_data$swing_E)

### Link clicks ### 

# Make a factor version for logistic regressions
sim_data$linkClicked <- as.factor(sim_data$linkClicked_n)

table(sim_data$linkClicked_n)
table(sim_data$linkClicked)

### Registration ### 

# Make a factor version for logistic regressions
sim_data$register <- as.factor(sim_data$register_n)

table(sim_data$register_n)
table(sim_data$register)

### Voting ### 

# Make a factor version for logistic regressions
sim_data$vote <- as.factor(sim_data$vote_n)

table(sim_data$vote_n)
table(sim_data$vote)

```

```{r, Center Continuous Variables}

### Age ###

# Center age
sim_data$age_c <- scale(sim_data$age, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
mean(sim_data$age_c, na.rm = TRUE) 

# High and low age
sim_data$age_low <- sim_data$age_c - (-sd(sim_data$age, na.rm = T)) # Using values from sim data
sim_data$age_high <- sim_data$age_c - (sd(sim_data$age, na.rm = T))

### Ideology ###

# Make moderate the mid point 
sim_data$ide_c <- sim_data$ide - 50

# Liberal and conservative for simple effects
sim_data$ide_low <- sim_data$ide_c - (-30)
sim_data$ide_high <- sim_data$ide_c - (30)

### Income ###

# Center income
sim_data$income_c <- scale(sim_data$income, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
mean(sim_data$income_c, na.rm = TRUE) 

# High and low income

sim_data$income_high <- sim_data$income_c - (sd(sim_data$income, na.rm = T))

sim_data$edu_high <- sim_data$edu_c - (sd(sim_data$edu, na.rm = T))
```

```{r, Standardize}

# Standardize continuous variables (do not center ideology)
dvs_stand <- sim_data[, c("age_c", "income_c", "edu_c", "pre_intention_c", "interest_c", 
                    "knowledge_c", "trust_branch_c", "trust_elect_c", "efficacy_c", 
                    "trust_agg_c", "norms_c", "voteInt", "ide_c", "COVI_c", "linkClicked_n", 
                    "register_n", "vote_n", "reg_confirm_ny", "reg_confirm_nl")]  %>%
  mutate(
    across(c("age_c", "income_c", "edu_c", "pre_intention_c", "interest_c", 
             "knowledge_c", "trust_branch_c", "trust_elect_c", "efficacy_c", 
             "trust_agg_c", "norms_c", "COVI_c", "voteInt", "linkClicked_n", 
             "register_n", "vote_n"), ~ scale(.x, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)[, 1])
  )
dvs_stand

# Combine with non-standardized variables that we need to keep
zsim_data <- cbind(sim_data[, c("ResponseId", "condition", "state", "gend_e", "gend_bin", "gend_bin_r", "ide_c", 
                    "race_bin_e", "race_bin", "race_bin_r", "White_E", "Black_E", 
                    "Latinx_E", "Asian_E", "ME_E", "Native_E", "Multiracial_E", 
                    "Other_E", 'swing_E', 'swing', 'swing_r', "vote_today_bin", 
                    "condition_binary","linkClicked", "register", "vote"), drop = TRUE], 
  as.data.frame(dvs_stand)
)

# Standardize ideology (but do not center)
zsim_data$ide_c <- zsim_data$ide_c/(sd(zsim_data$ide_c, na.rm = TRUE))
sd(zsim_data$ide_c, na.rm = T)

# Standardized low and high ideology

# Equal to 30 points in unstandardized units
highlowvalue <- 30/sd(sim_data$ide_c, na.rm = T) 

zsim_data$ide_low <- zsim_data$ide_c - (-highlowvalue) # Equal to 30 points in unstandardized units
zsim_data$ide_high <- zsim_data$ide_c - (highlowvalue) # Equal to 30 points in unstandardized units

# Standardized high and low income
zsim_data$income_low <- zsim_data$income_c - (-1)
zsim_data$income_high <- zsim_data$income_c - (1)

# Standardized high and low education
zsim_data$edu_low <- zsim_data$edu_c - (-1)
zsim_data$edu_high <- zsim_data$edu_c - (1)

# Standardized high and low age
zsim_data$age_low <- zsim_data$age_c - (-1)
zsim_data$age_high <- zsim_data$age_c - (1)

# Standardized high and low interest
zsim_data$interest_low <- zsim_data$interest_c - (-1)
zsim_data$interest_high <- zsim_data$interest_c - (1)

# Standardized high and low political knowledge

zsim_data$knowledge_low <- zsim_data$knowledge_c - (-1)
zsim_data$knowledge_high <- zsim_data$knowledge_c - (1)

# Standardized high and low trust in branches of government
zsim_data$trust_branch_low <- zsim_data$trust_branch_c - (-1)
zsim_data$trust_branch_high <- zsim_data$trust_branch_c - (1)

# Standardized high and low trust in fairness of elections
zsim_data$trust_elect_low <- zsim_data$trust_elect_c - (-1)
zsim_data$trust_elect_high <- zsim_data$trust_elect_c - (1)

# Standardized high and low generalized trust
zsim_data$trust_agg_low <- zsim_data$trust_agg_c - (-1)
zsim_data$trust_agg_high <- zsim_data$trust_agg_c - (1)

# Standardized high and low efficacy
zsim_data$efficacy_low <- zsim_data$efficacy_c - (-1)

zsim_data$efficacy_high <- zsim_data$efficacy_c - (1)

# Standardized high and low norms
zsim_data$norms_low <- zsim_data$norms_c - (-1)
zsim_data$norms_high <- zsim_data$norms_c - (1)

# High and low COVI
zsim_data$COVI_low <- zsim_data$COVI_c - (-1)
zsim_data$COVI_high <- zsim_data$COVI_c - (1)

# High and low pre-intervention intention to register
zsim_data$pre_intention_low <- zsim_data$pre_intention_c - (-1)
zsim_data$pre_intention_high <- zsim_data$pre_intention_c - (1)

head(zsim_data)
```
